articles.title: Deepened bonds, strengthened partnerships: PM Modi concludes three-nation visit, departs from NZ to India
articles.summary: PM Modi concluded his three-nation visit to Indonesia, Australia and New Zealand, with New Zealand ties elevated to a Strategic Partnership and an ambitious roadmap unveiled for cooperation across multiple sectors.

articles.title: When India's Chandrayaan landed on Moon, all of New Zealand rejoiced: PM Modi hails increasing space sector collaboration
articles.summary: PM Modi praised India-New Zealand collaboration in the space sector, noting that New Zealand's technology contributed to India's successful Chandrayaan moon landing.

articles.title: Das Kadam, Das Ka Dam: Sambit Patra highlights 10 key outcomes of PM Modi's recent foreign visits
articles.summary: BJP MP Sambit Patra outlined ten key outcomes from PM Modi's recent visits to Indonesia, Australia, New Zealand and Seychelles, highlighting strengthened strategic, defence, economic and cultural partnerships.

articles.title: PM Modi hails outcomes from Indonesia visit as comprehensive, substantive and futuristic
articles.summary: PM Modi welcomed outcomes from discussions with Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto, including 20 Memorandums of Understanding on bilateral cooperation including the BrahMos missile system and educational institutes.

articles.title: PM Modi emplanes for New Delhi after concluding high-profile State visit to Seychelles
articles.summary: PM Modi concluded a three-day state visit to Seychelles as Guest of Honour for the nation's 50th independence anniversary, securing a $175 million economic development package and Rs 1,250 crore credit line.
